parameters: \n<Emilio Aguinaldo>We must unite. Not only in battle, but in governance.
\n<Emilio Aguinaldo>The Katipunan is no longer enough. We need a government.
We founded it, we sacrificed our lives for it.
\n<Aguinaldo>Because a secret society is no longer enough.
We need a republic. We need a constitution.
\n<Ricarte>If we need an election, let us have one.
\n<Andres Bonifacio>At Tejeros, on the twenty-second of March.
The agreement is made. But the room does not relax. The
division is now scheduled, not healed.
